hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; p=$(cygpath -u "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "$f"); d=$(cygpath -u "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || echo "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"); case "$p" in "$d"/frontend/*) cd "$d/frontend" && ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f";; esac; } || true
